svg.title: Harness Bridge current binding and host responsibilities
svg.desc: Gray nodes are host-provided capabilities, blue nodes are implemented bridge behavior, and green nodes reuse OpenShell and DSH. The host selects its code path or calls the bridge. OpenShell creates a fresh Docker sandbox for each DSH task. Owned cleanup and result authorization precede return to the host. Business authorization and actual delivery remain host responsibilities. This is a call flow, not a physical deployment topology. No warm pool or VM backend is implemented.
